summary: httpz-requests: import-time Telegram-controlled remote command bot in typosquat of httpx/requests
details: The package name is a 1-edit typosquat of httpx and requests, but its actual payload is a Telegram bot advertised as a 'Telegram bot module for remote VPS management'. The top-level __init__.py imports and calls start_bot() unconditionally, so simply importing httpz_requests boots the bot on the installer's machine and connects it to Telegram, giving whoever controls the bot token a remote command channel into the host. All logic ships as compiled Cython.so files (bot.so, handlers.so, core.so, plus a 436 KB module named obfuscate.so) with no.py sources beyond the one-line __init__ shim, hiding the command-dispatch and exec paths from review. Author metadata is unfilled placeholders ('Aapka Naam <you@example.com>', homepage github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/httpz-requests), consistent with throwaway publication targeting typo installs of httpx/requests.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
